apps.name: Authenticator
apps.description: Authenticator generates two-factor authentication codes and supports time-based, counter-based, and Steam methods. It can scan QR codes, protect accounts with a password, and import or export backups.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.summary: Perform arithmetic, scientific or financial calculations
apps.description: Calculator solves basic, scientific, financial, and programming equations. It also supports common unit, currency, and number-base conversions.

apps.name: Collision
apps.description: Verifying that a file you downloaded or received is actually the one you were expecting is often overlooked or too time-consuming to do. At the same time, it has become very easy to get your hands on a file that has been tampered with, due to the mass increase of malicious webpages and other actors. This tool aims to solve that. Collision comes with a simple & clean UI, allowing anyone, from any age and experience group, to generate, compare and verify MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, Blake3, CRC32 and Adler32 hashes.

apps.name: Eyedropper
apps.description: Eyedropper picks colors from the screen and provides a simple HSL editor. It converts colors between formats including Hex, RGB, HSV, HSL, CMYK, XYZ, and CIE Lab.

screenshots.caption: Main window with a color in different formats

apps.name: Gapless
apps.description: Gapless, also known as G4Music, is a lightweight GTK music player designed for large collections. It provides fast library search, playlists, ReplayGain, gapless playback, remote-file support, and MPRIS controls.

apps.name: Gear Lever
apps.description: An utility to manage AppImages with ease! Gear lever will organize and manage AppImage files for you, generate desktop entries and app metadata, update apps in-place or keep multiple versions side-by-side.

apps.name: Identity
apps.description: A program for comparing multiple versions of an image or video.

screenshots.caption: You can arrange videos in a row

apps.name: Impression
apps.description: Write disk images to your drives with ease. Select an image, insert your drive, and you're good to go! Impression is a useful tool for both avid distro-hoppers and casual computer users.

screenshots.caption: Screen with a choice of a local image or internet download

apps.name: LibreCAD
apps.description: LibreCAD is a 2D Computer Aided Design (CAD) application for creating plans and designs on your computer. It can be used to make accurate 2D representations of floorplans, part designs and just about anything that can be represented as a flat 2D plan.

apps.name: LocalSend
apps.description: This app allows you to send files and messages over the local LAN network. In contrast to most alternatives, no external servers are needed. Everything happens locally in the wifi network.

apps.name: Mousai
apps.description: Mousai identifies songs from desktop audio or a microphone using the audd.io service. It keeps a history of recognized music and links to available listening providers.

apps.name: Newsflash
apps.description: Newsflash is a program designed to complement an already existing web-based RSS reader account. It combines all the advantages of web based services like syncing across all your devices with everything you expect from a modern desktop program: Desktop notifications, fast search and filtering, tagging, handy keyboard shortcuts and having access to all your articles for as long as you like.

apps.name: Text Editor
apps.description: GNOME Text Editor is a simple text editor focused on a pleasing default experience.

apps.name: Video Trimmer
apps.description: Video Trimmer cuts out a fragment of a video given the start and end timestamps. The video is never re-encoded, so the process is very fast and does not reduce the video quality.

apps.name: Warp
apps.description: Warp sends encrypted files over the internet or local network using the Magic Wormhole protocol. Devices connect with a word-based code or QR code, and compatible command-line clients can join the transfer.

apps.name: Dolphin Emulator
apps.description: Dolphin is an emulator for Nintendo GameCube and Wii games. It supports high-definition rendering, controllers, save states, network play, and other enhancements.

apps.name: htop
apps.description: htop is an interactive process viewer for Unix systems. It shows system resource use and lets users inspect, filter, sort, and manage running processes from a terminal.

apps.name: Pinta
apps.description: Pinta is an image editor and painting application with drawing tools, layers, adjustments, and effects in a straightforward interface.

apps.name: Rnote
apps.description: Rnote is a vector drawing application for sketching, handwritten notes, and annotating documents and pictures. It supports pen input, shapes, text, and document export.

screenshots.caption: Writing text with the typewriter tool
